column1: # scripts/lib/guard-expectations.tsv — the REVIEWED expectation for every guard.
# Checked by scripts/check-guard-registry.mjs against a live derivation
# (scripts/lib/deriveGuardRegistry.mjs). The checker never writes this file.
# One guard per line, TAB-separated, sorted by path (byte order), no
# duplicates, no totals. Adding a guard = adding its line. Removing a guard,
# demoting critical 1->0, unwiring it from scripts/guards.txt (guards_txt
# 1->0), or dropping its assertion count = an explicit edit to its line,
# visible in review. Numeric columns are kept exact (ratchets): a rise must
# be recorded too, so a later drop back is still caught. "-" means none.
# derived line for one guard; a failing run prints it as well.
